title: Phase 5D-A failure-decomposition report
description: The committed Phase 5D-A findings. Every experiment in this report runs on a fresh unsealed development bank, so nothing here is promotion evidence. The Phase 5C result is quoted, never recomputed: 'phase5c_quoted_result' exists so that the negative baseline being explained is visible beside the diagnosis without being rewritten by it.

phase5c_negative_baseline.description: The frozen designation of the Phase 5C configuration. Metadata only: the designation must not alter the agent id it designates.

phase5c_quoted_result.description: Quoted from reports/phase5c/, not recomputed here.

phase5c_registry_digest_unchanged.description: The live Phase 5C registry digest, which must still equal the value committed in reports/phase5c/pimc_registry.json.

safety_cap_deviation.description: Phase 5D-A complete-match runs use a smaller per-leg deal cap than Phase 5C. Recorded explicitly because it induces censoring, and censoring is not missing-at-random: it removes the closest legs.

play_only_complete_match.description: Experiment A: the frozen reference chooses every contract, PIMC plays every card.

show_only_complete_match.description: Experiment B: PIMC chooses every contract, the frozen reference plays every card.

heterogeneous_full_pimc.description: Experiment C: one search seat with a frozen reference partner, reported per seat arrangement rather than pooled.

heterogeneous_play_only.description: Experiment D: the same seat-balanced design applied to the play-only variant.

decomposition.description: Contract, card-play, and rollout-mismatch decompositions over the frozen decision corpus.

convergence.description: Nested-budget action stability. Prefixes nest exactly, so a changed action means a changed opinion.

selected_path.description: The Phase 5D-A decision: which of paths A, B, C, or D the evidence selects, and what it licenses next.

not_run.description: Planned artifacts that were not produced, named rather than silently omitted.
